'''Sluis Van Habitation Sphere D''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Sluis system]]. The [[Sluissi]] [[Hass Sonax]] grew up in Sluis Van Habitation Sphere D along with her father and sisters.<ref name="J15" />
